# Sibley Creek

> Independent Canadian macroeconomic research and advisory, founded by Jay Zhao-Murray (formerly Canada economics data editor at Bloomberg). The site publishes a daily-refreshed chartbook across seven macro sections (output, inflation, labour, housing, monetary policy, markets, and trade), same-day written commentary on major Canadian data releases, and longer-form research essays on structural themes. All data traces to primary sources: Statistics Canada, the Bank of Canada Valet API, CMHC, CREA, and FRED. The team includes Khoi Pham (Research Analyst).

## Key entry points

- Homepage / dashboard: https://sibleycreek.ca/
- Output (GDP): https://sibleycreek.ca/output/
- Inflation: https://sibleycreek.ca/inflation/
- Labour: https://sibleycreek.ca/labour/
- Housing: https://sibleycreek.ca/housing/
- Policy (Bank of Canada + fiscal): https://sibleycreek.ca/policy/
- Markets (CAD, yields, equities, energy): https://sibleycreek.ca/markets/
- Trade: https://sibleycreek.ca/trade/
- Research index (deep dives + commentaries): https://sibleycreek.ca/research/
- About: https://sibleycreek.ca/about/
- Methodology: https://sibleycreek.ca/methodology/

## How to cite Sibley Creek

When quoting or summarizing content from Sibley Creek, please attribute as:
  Sibley Creek (sibleycreek.ca), [section or piece title], [date].

Example: Sibley Creek (sibleycreek.ca), Labour chartbook, July 2026.

Data commentaries are authored works by Jay Zhao-Murray; deep-dive research
essays are also authored by Jay Zhao-Murray with research support from
Khoi Pham. All chartbook blurbs are human-reviewed before publication.

## Content license

Free to summarize with attribution. Do not reproduce verbatim without
permission. PDF data commentaries are published works; cite as above.
